subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should visible `message(action=send)` deliveries resolve selected-model `responsePrefix` variables, and if so which live attempt context should they use outside the normal reply pipeline?
rationale: Current main intentionally skips unresolved selected-model templates to avoid leaking literals, so an automated fix would choose a runtime/product contract rather than repair a narrow implementation mistake.

options.title: Implement Live-Attempt Parity
options.body: Pass current attempt provider, model, full model, and thinking level into visible message-tool sends, with a diagnostic or skip path only when no live attempt context exists.

options.title: Document Reply-Only Variables
options.body: Keep static and identity prefixes on tool sends but scope provider/model/thinking variables to direct replies in docs and tests.

options.title: Fold Into Attribution Design
options.body: Defer this to broader model-attribution and fallback-visibility work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/33975.

recommendation.title: Implement Live-Attempt Parity
recommendation.body: Pass current attempt provider, model, full model, and thinking level into visible message-tool sends, with a diagnostic or skip path only when no live attempt context exists.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent adjacent history on the channel/reply-prefix surfaces and is the best available route for deciding the runtime contract.
